memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh gate failure branches that suppress-and-extract per-finding detail into a --findings-only FINDINGS_LIST array while their fail() hint says 're-run without --quiet for detail' carry a latent diagnosability bug: --quiet controls a different code path than --findings, so a plain non-quiet re-run prints nothing beyond the aggregate count. The fix is to print each extracted finding line unconditionally in the failure branch (fail()'s own [FAIL]/hint lines already bypass --quiet via unconditional stderr echo), while leaving the --findings FINDINGS_LIST population as an additive, unchanged-shape side effect. Grep for the exact self-referential hint text (pointing back at verify-deploy.sh itself, not a standalone underlying script) to find all affected gates precisely.

generate-context-line-counts.sh --write is repo-wide (recomputes line_count for every entry across every extension's index-entries.json), so a doc edit made anywhere in a task's own scope can introduce a NEW line_count mismatch that only surfaces when the full gate-3 doc-lint runs post-redeploy -- not just the pre-existing drift the task set out to fix. Always re-run --check (or the full doc-lint) after any content edit to a file with an index-entries.json line_count declaration, even when the edit's own phase already 'closed'.
